question: Who became the first batsman in the history of cricket to score 3 ODI double centuries? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/04/2021) Shift 1)
options: Rohit Sharma
Virender Sehwag
Virat Kohli
Sachin Tendulakar
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Rohit Sharma

Explanation:
Rohit Sharma became the first batsman in cricket history to score three ODI double centuries, achieving a unique record. He hit his first double hundred (209 runs) against Australia in Bangalore in 2013. His second was an unbeaten 264 against Sri Lanka in Kolkata in 2014, which remains the highest individual score in ODI cricket. He completed his third double century (208*) against Sri Lanka in Mohali in 2017. Before this feat, no batsman had scored more than two double centuries in ODIs. Rohit Sharma now holds the record for the most ODI double centuries, with a total of 3. This milestone cements his status as one of the greatest limited-overs openers.

1920

India first participated in the Olympic Games in 1920 at Antwerp, Belgium. At that time, India was part of the British Empire and competed as a British colony, not as an independent nation. India's first Olympic medal came in 1928 at the Amsterdam Olympics, when the Indian men's hockey team won a gold medal. In the 1920 Olympics, India competed in sports like athletics, wrestling, and tennis. India had earlier participation in the 1900 Paris Olympics, but that was an individual effort by an Anglo-Indian athlete, Norman Pritchard, and not as an official team. India won its first gold medal as an independent nation in 1948 London Olympics in hockey. The Indian Olympic Association was formed in 1927, after the 1920 participation.
